# What each regex does

<!-- Generated by scripts/build.mjs from scripts/regex-notes.json. Edit the notes, not this file. -->

Every preset ships with regex scripts that turn short tags into styled panels. Here's what each one does, and the tag the model writes to trigger it. You can also browse this on the site: https://howardsierra.github.io/Roleplay-Resources/regex.html

<a id="rosie"></a>
## 🌹 Rosie Full Bloom v2.7

Turn on Regex Keepsakes (or a board, report, or HEX/SELARU module) in the preset, and Rosie writes these short bracket tags. The regexes draw them as cards. Bundle: [`Rosie_regex_bundle.json`](Rosie_regex_bundle.json).

### Keepsakes

Small cards Rosie drops into the story.

- **🌹 Rosie Scene Compass**: A pink fold-out card for the current scene: place, time, who's present, mood, the live thread, and a one-line nudge. Tap the title to open it.
  `[RSCENE: title | place | time | present | mood | thread | nudge]`
- **💌 Rosie Ship Ledger**: A card for a pairing: where they stand, the heat, what's in the way, the payoff it's building to, and a note.
  `[RSHIP: pair | stage | heat | obstacle | payoff | note]`
- **📱 Rosie Phone Message**: Draws a text message as a phone screen, with the contact, time, delivery status, and message bubble.
  `[RPHONE: contact | time | status | message]`
- **🧭 Rosie Quest Card**: A quest card: the current step, what comes next, the risk, and the reward.
  `[RQUEST: title | current | next | risk | reward]`
- **🎁 Rosie Inventory Keepsake**: An item card: who owns it, what shape it's in, and what it means to them.
  `[RITEM: item | owner | state | meaning | note]`
- **👗 Rosie Wardrobe Card**: What a character is wearing right now, with their posture, one telling detail, and their mood.
  `[RWARDROBE: character | outfit | posture | detail | mood | note]`
- **🗣️ Rosie Rumor Board**: A rumor: who started it, who it's about, what's being said, how far it's spread, and what it'll cost.
  `[RRUMOR: source | subject | claim | spread | consequence]`
- **💞 Rosie Relationship Map**: Two people side by side, with the bond between them and the tension in it.
  `[RREL: title | person_a | person_b | bond | tension | note]`

### Info boards

Dashboards from the Info Board System. Each one also has an "Always Fire" module.

- **📋 Rosie General Info Board**: A general-purpose board: a title, two labeled values side by side, and a note.
  `[RBOARD: title | subtitle | left label | left value | right label | right value | note]`
- **📍 Rosie Status Board**: The scene at a glance: location, time, pressure, danger, the objective, and what's next.
  `[RSTATUS: title | location | time | pressure | danger | objective | next]`
- **👥 Rosie Cast Board**: Who's in the scene, who's nearby, who's missing, and the wild card.
  `[RCAST: title | active | nearby | absent | wild card | note]`
- **🧠 Rosie Knowledge Board**: What one character knows, suspects, and doesn't know, and the risk hiding in the gap.
  `[RKNOW: title | character | knows | suspects | does not know | risk]`
- **🕯️ Rosie Calendar / Countdown Board**: The date and time, with a countdown to the next deadline or event.
  `[RCLOCK: title | date | time | deadline | event | note]`
- **🗂️ Rosie Case Board**: A mystery case file: the lead, the evidence, the suspect, the contradiction, and the next step.
  `[RCASE: title | lead | evidence | suspect | contradiction | next]`
- **👑 Rosie Reputation Board**: How the world sees a character: the public read, allies, threats, gossip, and consequences.
  `[RREP: title | public read | allies | threats | gossip | consequence]`

### Status reports

F.A.Y.E.-inspired reports. Turn on the Status Report System and pick a style.

- **🌹 Rosie SFW Status Report**: A styled status report card for the scene, with Rosie's note at the bottom.
  `[RSFWREPORT: title | when/where | mood | pressure | thread | next opening | rosie note]`
- **🌹 Rosie SFW Markdown-Style Status**: A lighter, quote-style version of the same report.
  `[RSFWMD: title | when/where | mood | pressure | next opening | rosie note]`
- **🫦 Rosie Velvet Heat Report**: The adults-only report for intimate scenes: adult check, privacy, heat, consent and boundaries, emotional risk, and aftercare.
  `[RVELVET: title | adult check | privacy | heat | consent/boundaries | emotional risk | aftercare | next opening | rosie note]`
- **🫦 Rosie Velvet Markdown-Style Status**: A lighter, quote-style version of the Velvet Heat Report.
  `[RVELVETMD: title | adult check | privacy | heat | consent/boundaries | next opening | rosie note]`
- **🌹 Rosie AI Affinity Status Board**: The big screenshot-style panel: five stats with their latest changes, what the character understands about you, perceived threats, sweet and sad things, and an internal monologue.
  `[RAFFINITY: status | affection % | change | attraction % | change | loyalty % | change | intelligence % | change | intrigue % | change | understanding you | perceived threats | sweet things | sad things | internal monologue]`

### HEX- and SELARU-style boards

Alternate board styles inspired by HEX's environmental boards and SELARU's in-world objects. Commands like [ROSIE:HEX INFO] call them up.

- **🔥 Rosie HEX-Style Info Board**: An environmental board: date, season, how much time passed, location, temperature, weather, light, and scene pressure.
  `[RHEXINFO: date | season | start time | end time | location | temperature | weather/visibility/light | illumination | scene pressure]`
- **🔥 Rosie HEX-Style Affinity Board**: An affinity board for one character: their read on things, mood, affinity, tension, and physical state, plus a soundtrack and a scenery line.
  `[RHEXAFF: focus | thought/meta read | mood | affinity | heat/tension | physical state | soundtrack | scenery]`
- **🌹 Rosie HEX-Style SFW Affinity Board**: The SFW version: public read, mood, affinity, tension, and posture.
  `[RHEXAFFSFW: focus | public read | mood | affinity | tension | posture | soundtrack | scenery]`
- **🫦 Rosie HEX-Style Velvet Affinity Board**: The adults-only version, with an adult check, privacy, heat, consent and boundaries, and aftercare.
  `[RHEXAFFNSFW: focus | adult check | privacy | heat | consent/boundaries | arousal/tension | physical state | aftercare/aftermath | note]`
- **🪞 Rosie SELARU-Style Diegetic Info Board**: Shows information as an object in the story world, like a sign, a note, or a screen: what it says, how it's used, and how the character reacts.
  `[RSELINFO: object type | title | source | visible text/detail | interaction | consequence | character reaction]`
- **🪞 Rosie SELARU-Style Affinity Evidence Board**: Affinity told through evidence you could actually see instead of a number: what's visible, whether it's public, trust, pressure, and risk.
  `[RSELAFF: pair/focus | visible evidence | private/public status | trust | pressure | risk | next opening]`
- **📜 Rosie SELARU-Style Document Board**: An in-world document such as a letter, contract, or decree, with its issuer, contents, seal, and consequence.
  `[RSELDOC: document type | title | issuer/source | contents | seal/status | consequence | note]`
- **🖥️ Rosie SELARU-Style Terminal Board**: An in-world terminal or device screen, with its status, message, warning, and an action prompt.
  `[RSELTERM: interface | status | signal/source | message | warning | action prompt | consequence]`

### Behind the scenes

These hide things rather than draw them.

- **🌹 Rosie Secret Stitch Note**: Takes Rosie's private continuity notes out of the reply and files them in the rosie_notes chat variable, so they're remembered but never shown. _(Edits the message itself)_
  `[ROSIE NOTE: note]`
- **🌹 Rosie Chekhov Plant**: Files a planted setup (a Chekhov's gun) in the rosie_planted chat variable instead of showing it. _(Edits the message itself)_
  `[PLANT: setup]`
- **🌹 Rosie Chekhov Fired**: Logs a payoff in the rosie_fired chat variable when a planted setup goes off. _(Edits the message itself · Also runs on your messages)_
  `[FIRED: payoff]`
- **🌹 Rosie HTML Marker Cleanup**: Removes the invisible ROSIE_HTML start and end markers around Rosie's HTML panels.
- **🌹 Rosie Macro Cleanup**: Hides any leftover {{addvar}}, {{setvar}}, {{getvar}}, {{incvar}}, or {{decvar}} macros so they never show up in a reply.
- **🌹 Rosie Prefill Strip**: Removes a "[Continuing in-character…]" prefill if the model echoes it at the start of a reply. _(Edits the message itself)_

## 🥀 The Velvet Vigil v3.2.2

Turn on 🧵 Loom Mode in the preset, and Vesper writes these light tags instead of full HTML. It's cheaper on tokens and keeps the look consistent. Bundle: [`Velvet_Vigil_regex_bundle.json`](Velvet_Vigil_regex_bundle.json).

### Loom fixtures

- **VV - Chapter Plate**: A centered chapter plate: the number and title in small caps over an italic epigraph.
  `<plate>Number · Title ♦ epigraph</plate>`
- **VV - Scene Ledger**: The Scene Ledger: when, where, who's present, and the open threads.
  `<ledger>when ♦ where ♦ present ♦ threads</ledger>`
- **VV - Ribbon Ledger**: The Ribbon Ledger for one bond: Affection, Desire, and Trust meters, each with its number and stage.
  `<ribbon>Name ♦ Affection NN Stage ♦ Desire NN Stage ♦ Trust NN Stage</ribbon>`
- **VV - Ribbon Delta Chip**: A small inline chip for a change to a bond, with the reason.
  `[+4 Trust: reason]`
- **VV - Vesper Remark**: Vesper's signed remark under a reply, in her burgundy margin style.
  `<vesper>remark</vesper>`
- **VV - Reading Room Patron**: One Reading Room reader's reaction, with their @handle.
  `<patron handle="name">comment</patron>`
- **VV - Crossroads Fork**: Draws each of Vesper's Crossroads options as a pill-shaped choice.
  `<fork>option</fork>`
- **VV - Night Reading Veil**: Wraps the model's reasoning in a 🕯️ "the night reading" fold-out, so it doesn't sprawl across the reply.
  `<think>…</think>`

<a id="lovesick"></a>
## 💌 LOVESICK v1.4.1

Turn on 📶 Signal Mode in the preset, and Juno writes these light tags instead of full HTML. It's cheaper on tokens and keeps the look consistent. Bundle: [`LOVESICK_regex_bundle.json`](LOVESICK_regex_bundle.json).

### Screenlife fixtures

- **LS - Chapter Card**: A chapter card with its number and title over an italic epigraph.
  `<chapter>No. · title ♦ epigraph</chapter>`
- **LS - The Receipts**: The Receipts: when, where, who's there, and the threads in play.
  `<receipts>when ♦ where ♦ present ♦ threads</receipts>`
- **LS - The Pinboard**: The detailed scene board: when, where, the room, fit check, the vibe, threads, and what's up next. It replaces The Receipts when both are on.
  `<pinboard>when ♦ where ♦ the room ♦ fit check ♦ the vibe ♦ threads ♦ up next</pinboard>`
- **LS - Group Chat Name**: The group chat's name, as a header above its messages.
  `<gcname>chat title</gcname>`
- **LS - Group Chat Message**: One group chat bubble with the sender's name.
  `<gc handle="name">message</gc>`
- **LS - Delulu Meter**: The Delulu Meter for a pairing: Feelings, Heat, and Honesty bars, each with its number and stage.
  `<delulu>Name ♦ Feelings NN Stage ♦ Heat NN Stage ♦ Honesty NN Stage</delulu>`
- **LS - Delulu Delta Chip**: A small inline chip for a change to Feelings, Heat, or Honesty, with the reason.
  `[+6 Honesty: reason]`
- **LS - Juno Comment**: Juno's signed comment under a reply, liveblogging your love life.
  `<juno>comment</juno>`
- **LS - What They Didnt Say**: A 🤫 fold-out holding the line someone didn't say out loud.
  `<unsaid>the line</unsaid>`
- **LS - The Firsts**: A 💌 fold-out checklist of the relationship's firsts, done and not yet.
  `<firsts>✓/○ lines</firsts>`
- **LS - Needle Drop**: A small "♪ now playing" line for the scene's song.
  `<track>Song — Artist</track>`
- **LS - Margin Notes (think)**: Juno's readable reasoning: wraps <think> in a 🖊️ "juno's margin notes" fold-out. You don't need it if SillyTavern's Auto-Parse Reasoning already catches <think> tags.
  `<think>…</think>`

<a id="callboard"></a>
## 📋 CALLBOARD v1.4.0

CALLBOARD writes data lines, like TW> msg|… for a Twitch message, inside [[SHELL]] tags. Row regexes draw each line, and shell regexes draw the window around them. They ship inside the preset: allow them when SillyTavern asks, or import the bundle. CALLBOARD Lite v1.4.0 uses exactly the same regex. Bundle: [`CALLBOARD_regex_bundle.json`](CALLBOARD_regex_bundle.json).

### Dividers

These also work in your own messages.

- **CB · Divider — Act Break**: Turns the line into a ✦ ✦ ✦ act break. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `a line of ---, ***, ===, or ~~~`
- **CB · Divider — Scene Shift (⁂)**: Turns it into a centered scene-shift mark. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `⁂ on its own line`
- **CB · Divider — Timeskip (↷)**: Turns it into a "later" timeskip divider. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `↷, »»», or →→→ on its own line`

### Cue Calls and The Program

New in v1.4: Xavi tells you what's about to appear, and what's lit tonight.

- **CB · Cue — standby slip (with legend)**: A gold ● STANDBY slip above whatever's about to appear, with a "What it means" legend. Xavi includes the legend the first time each kind of element shows up. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `CUE> icon|what's coming|why now|what it means`
- **CB · Cue — standby slip**: The same STANDBY slip without the legend, for elements you've already seen. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `CUE> icon|what's coming|why now|`
- **CB · Cue — catch-all (malformed lines)**: Catches cue lines with the wrong number of fields and shows them as a plain STANDBY line. _(Also runs on your messages)_
- **CB · Shell — The Program**: The theatre-program card listing everything that's lit. It appears on the first reply of a chat, and whenever you send [PROGRAM]. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[PROGRAM]] … [[/PROGRAM]]`
- **CB · Program row — title**: The program's title: tonight's production in a phrase. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `PG> title|tonight's production`
- **CB · Program row — cast line**: The line under the title: the setting wing, mode, and Xavi's patter and mood. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `PG> cast|wing · mode · patter and mood`
- **CB · Program row — act**: One lit module per line: what sets it off (CUE) and what you'll see. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `PG> act|icon|module|what sets it off|what you'll see`
- **CB · Program row — note from Xavi**: A closing note from Xavi to the director, signed — X. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `PG> note|line`
- **CB · Program row — catch-all (malformed lines)**: Catches program lines with the wrong number of fields and shows them as plain text. _(Also runs on your messages)_

### Xavi

Your stage manager's notes and asides.

- **CB · Callboard — style think foldout**: Shows Xavi's reasoning as a 🎧 "Xavi at the board" fold-out. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `<think>…</think>`
- **CB · Callboard — hide think from prompt**: Leaves Xavi's <think> notes out of what's sent back to the model on later turns, to save tokens. What you see doesn't change. _(Only changes what the model sees · Also runs on your messages)_
- **CB · Xavi — curtain note (style)**: Xavi's curtain note: a 🎧 card under the reply. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `<xavi>note</xavi>`
- **CB · Xavi — curtain note (hide from prompt)**: Leaves Xavi's curtain notes out of what's sent back to the model, so they cost no tokens later. _(Only changes what the model sees · Also runs on your messages)_
- **CB · Xavi — OOC aside (style, AI output only)**: Styles Xavi's (OOC: …) asides as a "from the wings" note signed — X. It only touches the AI's replies, so your own OOC stays plain.
  `(OOC: aside)`

### Tracker and boards

Written inside one <cb_state> block. Shell regexes draw each card, and row regexes draw the lines inside it.

- **CB · Tracker shell**: Wraps the tracker lines in the 🎛️ Status card. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[TRK]] … [[/TRK]]`
- **CB · Tracker row — line**: A label-and-value line in the Status card for the time, place, or mood. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `T> time|… · T> place|… · T> mood|…`
- **CB · Tracker row — affinity**: An affinity bar for the focus character, with the reason underneath. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `T> affinity|name|0–100|why`
- **CB · Tracker row — reputation**: A reputation line, with the reason underneath. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `T> reputation|standing|why`
- **CB · Board shell — Cast**: Wraps Cast & Affinity rows in their card. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[CAST]] … [[/CAST]]`
- **CB · Board row — Cast**: A Cast row: role, an affinity bar, mood, and status. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `C> name|role|0–100|mood|status`
- **CB · Board shell — Web**: Wraps Relationship Web rows in their card. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[WEB]] … [[/WEB]]`
- **CB · Board row — Web**: A Relationship Web row: the pair, their bond, its strength, and a note. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `W> A ↔ B|bond|0–100|note`
- **CB · Board shell — Status**: Wraps Status & Conditions rows in their card. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[STATUS]] … [[/STATUS]]`
- **CB · Board row — Status**: A Status & Conditions row: ♥ health, ⚡ energy, and what's wrong. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `S> name|health|energy|condition`
- **CB · Board shell — Inventory**: Wraps Inventory & Keepsakes rows in their card. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[INV]] … [[/INV]]`
- **CB · Board row — Inventory**: An Inventory & Keepsakes row. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `I> item|type|note`
- **CB · Board shell — Codex**: Wraps World Codex rows in their card. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[CODEX]] … [[/CODEX]]`
- **CB · Board row — Codex**: A World Codex / Clue Log row: a faction, place, mystery, or clue. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `X> entry|type|note`
- **CB · Board row — catch-all (malformed lines)**: Catches tracker or board lines with the wrong number of fields and shows them as plain text instead of a broken row. _(Also runs on your messages)_
- **CB · State — unwrap (keep rendered cards)**: Removes the <cb_state> wrapper so only the finished cards show. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `<cb_state> … </cb_state>`

### Twitch

Written inside [[TWITCH]] … [[/TWITCH]].

- **CB · Shell — Twitch chat**: The Twitch chat window that floats beside the prose, with its "Send a message" box. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[TWITCH]] … [[/TWITCH]]`
- **CB · Twitch row — live header**: The stream header: channel, LIVE badge, title, category, viewer count, and uptime. _(Also runs on your messages)_

- **CB · Twitch row — message**: A chat message, with badges and the viewer's name color. _(Also runs on your messages)_

- **CB · Twitch row — sub / gift**: A highlighted sub or gift-sub alert. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `TW> sub|user|kind|message`
- **CB · Twitch row — bits**: A cheer with bits. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `TW> bits|user|amount|message`
- **CB · Twitch row — tip (TTS)**: A TTS donation alert, the kind the streamer hears read out loud. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `TW> tip|user|$amount|message`
- **CB · Twitch row — raid**: A raid alert. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `TW> raid|channel|viewers`
- **CB · Twitch row — follow**: A new-follower line. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `TW> follow|user`
- **CB · Twitch row — mod action**: A mod action, like a timeout. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `TW> mod|what happened`
- **CB · Twitch row — clip**: A ✂️ clip card. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `TW> clip|title|clipped by`
- **CB · Twitch inline — @mention**: Highlights @mentions in Twitch chat. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `@username`

### Discord

Written inside [[DISCORD]] … [[/DISCORD]].

- **CB · Shell — Discord window**: The Discord window around the messages, with its message box. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[DISCORD]] … [[/DISCORD]]`
- **CB · Discord row — place header**: The server and channel header, or Direct Messages. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `DC> place|server|#channel`
- **CB · Discord row — message (no tag)**: A message from someone without a role badge. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `DC> msg|#color|name||time|message`
- **CB · Discord row — message (tagged)**: A message with a role badge like MOD, or a joke role. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `DC> msg|#color|name|tag|time|message`
- **CB · Discord row — grouped follow-up**: A follow-up grouped under the same person's last message. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `DC> more|message`
- **CB · Discord row — reply line**: The small "replying to" line above a reply. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `DC> reply|name|snippet`
- **CB · Discord row — reactions**: Reaction pills under a message. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `DC> react|💀 4 · 😭 2`
- **CB · Discord row — attachment**: An image or file attachment. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `DC> attach|what it is`
- **CB · Discord row — system line**: A system line, like a pinned message, a join, or a call. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `DC> sys|line`
- **CB · Discord row — typing**: The typing indicator. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `DC> typing|Mara is typing…`
- **CB · Discord inline — @mention**: Highlights @mentions, Discord-style. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `@name`
- **CB · Discord inline — (edited)**: Turns "(edited)" into Discord's small grey tag. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `(edited)`
- **CB · Discord inline — split reactions**: Splits a reactions line into separate pills. _(Also runs on your messages)_
- **CB · Chat inline — emotes :Name: (Twitch/Discord)**: Turns emotes in Twitch and Discord lines into emote pills. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `:KEKW:`

- **CB · Reddit inline — (OP) tag**: Turns "(OP)" after a username into Reddit's OP badge. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `(OP)`
- **CB · Reddit inline — EDIT:**: Bolds "EDIT:" in posts and comments. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `EDIT:`

### Y2K comms

For the Y2K wing: AIM, flip phones, and MySpace.

- **CB · Shell — AIM window**: The AIM chat window. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[AIM]] … [[/AIM]]`
- **CB · AIM row — window bar**: The window's title bar, with the buddy's status. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `AIM> win|screen name|status`
- **CB · AIM row — red (you)**: Your character's messages, in AIM red. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `AIM> red|ScreenName|time|message`
- **CB · AIM row — blue (them)**: The other person's messages, in AIM blue. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `AIM> blue|ScreenName|time|message`
- **CB · AIM row — away message**: An away message. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `AIM> away|ScreenName|message`
- **CB · AIM row — system**: A system line, like someone signing off. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `AIM> sys|line`
- **CB · Shell — Flip phone**: The flip phone around the texts. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[FLIP]] … [[/FLIP]]`
- **CB · Flip row — header**: The phone's screen header. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `FLIP> head|contact|carrier + time`
- **CB · Flip row — received**: A received text. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `FLIP> in|text|time`
- **CB · Flip row — sent**: A sent text. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `FLIP> out|text|time`
- **CB · Shell — MySpace comments**: The MySpace comment wall. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `[[MYSPACE]] … [[/MYSPACE]]`
- **CB · MySpace row — header**: The profile header, with their mood. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `MS> head|name|mood`
- **CB · MySpace row — Top 8**: The Top 8. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `MS> top8|names, comma-separated`
- **CB · MySpace row — comment**: A wall comment. _(Also runs on your messages)_
  `MS> comment|name|date|comment`

### Plumbing and extras

- **CB · Chat/Press row — catch-all (malformed lines)**: Catches chat or press lines with the wrong number of fields and shows them as plain text instead of breaking the panel. _(Also runs on your messages)_
- **CB · Chat/Press — join rendered rows**: Removes the line breaks between drawn rows so panels don't get gaps. _(Also runs on your messages)_
- **CB · Visuals — collapse old chat/press blocks in prompt (optional)**: Swaps chat panels, press pages, and the Program for a short placeholder in what's sent to the model once they're six or more messages old, to save tokens. What you see doesn't change. _(Only changes what the model sees · Also runs on your messages)_
- **CB · Extreme — Pollinations image**: Turns an image directive into a picture generated by Pollinations (Flux, 1024×1024). It's the only regex that loads anything from outside, so it needs "Forbid External Media" turned off.
  `<cb_img>prompt: … | ar: 16:9</cb_img>`
